name: Langfuse
description: Langfuse is an open-source LLM engineering platform. It records traces, token usage and costs from LLM applications and agents, and adds evaluations, prompt management and analytics dashboards.

notes.text: There is no default account. Create your account in the web interface, then set AUTH_DISABLE_SIGNUP=true in /opt/langfuse_data/.env and restart langfuse-web.
Behind a reverse proxy, set NEXTAUTH_URL in /opt/langfuse_data/.env to the external URL and restart langfuse-web.
Media uploads and batch exports are not configured; they need an S3 endpoint reachable by clients.
